accepted.detail: a notice, which detection does not read
accepted.reason: cited by where it was published rather than by a number of its own, and detection does not read an Official Journal reference, so the instrument is not reported at all. The largest single gap these keys show: in competition practice the Commission's own notices and guidelines are among the most-cited instruments there are, and every short form a document then uses for one has nothing to resolve against

The same gap as the notice missed above, seen from the other side; it is reported, not guessed
